name: Nodepop
//: overrides.qs: express 4 and body-parser 1 pin qs to ~6.15, and 6.15.3 is the
last release of two advisories (array-limit bypass GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx, and
isBuffer DoS GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g) fixed in 6.16.0, which no express 4 release
requires yet. The alternative npm offers is `npm audit fix --force`, which
installs express 5 - a breaking change this app is not ready for. The query
parser is what every request goes through, so the patched line is forced for
every dependant instead. Remove this once `npm ls qs` stops reporting
"overridden", which means express and body-parser require 6.16 on their own.
